item.title: Poundland owner to hold crunch talks with business secretary
item.body: Gordon Brothers will meet Jonathan Reynolds on Wednesday as the investment firm faces scrutiny over Poundland, whose collapse looms.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏪 Poundland owner to hold crunch talks with business secretary

Gordon Brothers will meet Jonathan Reynolds on Wednesday as the investment firm faces scrutiny over Poundland, whose collapse looms.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 12:50
